about: The extension SDK's scales (cmux-extension-sdk tokens.ts: SPACE, RADIUS, DURATION), each step tied to the app's own scale it comes from, so an extension cannot drift from the app (RFD component-libraries, item 12). `from` names the app step: `design-scale:spacing.N` (design-scale.json spacing.steps), `design-scale:spacing.layout.I`, `design-scale:radii.NAME`, `design-scale:namedRadii.NAME`, `layout-grid:NAME` (layout-grid.json metrics) or `motion-scale:NAME`. A step with `from: null` is the scene DSL's own and says why. scripts/cmux-next/gen-type-scale.py writes `px`/`ms` from `from` and the SDK's tables from this file; its --check fails when either drifted. The type roles come from schemas/type-scale/scene-type.json. `differs` records where the SDK and the app name the same thing differently today: proposals, not applied (renders nothing new).
